name: reorganize-web-ui
title: Reorganize Web UI Around Emby Core
description: Reorganize the maintained Web UI around the remaining Emby-focused viewing and administration capabilities.
scope: web frontend information architecture and responsive navigation
creator: AceCandy
notes: Implemented the approved four-destination viewer space, canonical query views, shared route/access manifest, user-bound permissions, bounded poster loading, contextual DLNA, and /admin/* management shell. Final lint, production build, diff check, Trellis validation, legacy-link scan, sensitive-artifact scan, and mocked authenticated browser checks passed at 390x844, 768x1024, 1024x768, and 1440x900. Real-backend authenticated media mutations were not exercised because no valid local test session was available; browser mocks were isolated and removed.
